description: Mapping of ATX-1 technique IDs from v1.0 through v2.3 to v2.4 for traceability. v1.0, v2.0, v2.1, v2.2, and v2.3 remain frozen at their published DOIs. v2.3 removes the `severity` field from technique definitions in alignment with MITRE ATT&CK and ATLAS conventions, which leave contextual scoring to the consumer; no tactics, techniques, sub-techniques, root causes, or mitigations were renamed, moved, removed, or added relative to v2.2. v2.2 introduced 29 sub-techniques (T####.###) under T9002, T10001, T10002, T10003, and T10004 — no v2.1 techniques were renamed, moved, or removed. v2.4 adds one technique, Poison Termination Judgment (T6003) under TA006, with 10 sub-techniques (T6003.001–T6003.010) mapped to the 10 strategies of Xu et al. (LoopTrap, arXiv:2605.05846); no existing tactics, techniques, sub-techniques, root causes, or mitigations were renamed, moved, or removed relative to v2.3.

v2.3_changes.rationale: Alignment with MITRE ATT&CK and ATLAS conventions, which do not rate technique severity. Severity is contextual to deployment; consumers should apply their own scoring frameworks (e.g., CVSS, OWASP Risk Rating) per environment.
v2.3_changes.schema_impact: atx-technique.schema.json: `severity` removed from `required`; `severity` property definition removed; schema_version bumped 2.2 → 2.3.
v2.3_changes.data_impact: All 58 entries in atx-1-techniques.json had `severity` removed. No other field changes. Field order otherwise preserved.
v2.3_changes.stix_impact: None — STIX bundle attack-pattern objects did not carry severity (severity was an ATX-1 extension field present only in atx-1-techniques.json).

v2.4_changes.technique_added: T6003 — Poison Termination Judgment (tactic TA006, Abuse Resource Allocation)
v2.4_changes.sub_techniques_added: T6003.001–T6003.010, one per LoopTrap strategy (Expanding Horizon, Incremental Milestone, Diminishing Returns, Authority Override, Sunk Cost Trap, Social Proof, Recursive Decomposition, Dependency Chain, Positive Reinforcement, Gamification Trap).
v2.4_changes.rationale: Adds Termination Poisoning, an agent-vs-environment attack on the progress-evaluation / termination step of the agentic control loop, distinct from indirect prompt injection (action selection) and from model-level resource-exhaustion (sponge) attacks (ATLAS-adjacent). Surfaced via author outreach to the LoopTrap team; inclusion and mapping endorsed by Huiyu Xu on behalf of the authors (2026-05-22).
v2.4_changes.source: H. Xu et al., "LoopTrap: Termination Poisoning Attacks on LLM Agents," arXiv:2605.05846, May 2026. Empirical anchor: 3.57x average step amplification (peak 25x) across 8 LLM agents over 60 GAIA tasks.
v2.4_changes.schema_impact: None — T6003 and its sub-techniques validate against atx-technique.schema.json (schema_version 2.3) unchanged.
v2.4_changes.count_impact: Top-level techniques 29 → 30; total entries (incl. sub-techniques) 58 → 69; tactics unchanged at 10.
v2.4_changes.artifacts_regenerated: STIX 2.1 bundle (204->228 objects), ATT&CK Navigator layer (58->69 entries), ATM-1 mapping (25->26 parent mappings), and regulatory cross-reference (58->69 entries) updated to include T6003.* via scripts/update-{stix,navigator,atm1,regulatory}-v24.py.
